results.body_snippet: ### The idea, in a paragraph Offer an opt-in native Rust-call quarantine: a supervised worker computes on bounded, copied values while the Go host owns request state. results.title: parse_duration drops the days (d) unit
results.author: tine1117
results.body_snippet: ## Bug `parse_duration` silently drops the **days** (`d`) unit.
